channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermes-tenuo (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: hermes-tenuo checks tool calls and their arguments against signed, expiring permissions before they reach tool handlers. It also supports narrowing permissions for subagents and includes Hands, which lets a remote Hermes work with a folder on a connected laptop using an OS sandbox.

item.title: Open-Agent-API (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Open Agent API exposes agents through an API, where callers identify an agent rather than a model. The README describes using OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini SDK clients with the gateway, and supports agents with their own tools, persistent context across turns, and approval pauses for sensitive actions.

item.title: Wiro-Hermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Wiro-Hermes provides two plugins for Hermes Agent: `wiro-media` adds tools for image, video, speech, music, transcription, and 3D tasks, while `wiro` adds Wiro AI’s LLM gateway as a model provider. Both use a Wiro AI API key; the gateway offers GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, and Grok models through an OpenAI-compatible API.

item.title: youtube-transcript-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: An Agent Skill that lets compatible AI agents fetch YouTube transcripts, search videos and channels, browse channel uploads and playlists, and retrieve other video and channel information through the getyoutubetranscript.com API. The README documents installation options, API-key setup, and endpoints for tasks including transcript retrieval, channel search, and playlist contents.

item.title: hermes-guests (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Guests lets an owner share selected Hermes tools with people using a Telegram bot. Each guest has a separate profile, conversations, and memory, and access requires an owner-approved signed warrant that limits tools and duration.

item.title: scavio-hermes-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides a hosted MCP server for structured data from 31 platforms and an Extract endpoint for URLs. It includes five workflow skills for product research, competitor analysis, price comparison, Reddit sentiment, and YouTube research.

item.title: agent-browser-mcp (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Agent-browser-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact directly with a user's active Chrome browser session rather than a sandboxed environment. It works through a local bridge and a Chrome extension to maintain existing login states, cookies, and open tabs while providing low-level control. item.title: ai-emotion-chip (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Emotion Chip is a Hermes Agent plugin that lets the agent add delivery cues, such as whispers, sighs, and pauses, to text. It renders those cues for ElevenLabs v4 or Fish Audio and includes commands to inspect cue rendering and check voice setup.

item.title: hermes-cloud-file-manager (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Cloud File Manager lets you browse, search, upload, and download files and folders on the machine running a Hermes agent from Hermes Desktop. It can preview supported files, lets you review Markdown and text edits before saving, and can optionally browse and import files from Google Drive when the agent is signed in through its google-workspace skill.

item.title: heartbeat2 (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: HeartBeat 2.0 is a Hermes plugin that schedules agent turns for reminders, recurring work, roles, and watcher checks. It uses code checks to determine whether work is due before starting a model turn, and provides commands such as `/pulse` to show upcoming work and trigger history.

item.title: fish-audio-hermes (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Fish Audio for Hermes is a plugin that adds Fish Audio speech and transcription features to Hermes CLI, supported messaging apps, and the Desktop app. It provides voice search and selection, voice cloning and design, speech-to-text, and commands for setup and account status.

item.title: hermes-personal-assistant (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Personal Assistant is a Hermes plugin that carries context and follow-through across conversations and workflows. It prepares actions on real sites, presents an approval packet, and stops before the final action until you approve; it also supports workflows for calendars, inboxes, meetings, household administration, shopping, and travel.

item.title: caduceus (Domain Applications)
item.description: Caduceus is a Hermes plugin that combines DNA data, Apple Health exports, and health records in a SQLite vault on the user's machine. It provides cited answers drawing on personal data and research, and can create a health brief for a clinician.

item.title: boardstate-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Boardstate is a Hermes plugin that lets an agent create and update a board of KPI cards, tables, charts, notes, and other widgets. The board is saved in the user’s Hermes home and can be viewed in the Hermes web dashboard or Hermes Desktop.

item.title: glasses-platform (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Glasses is a Hermes Agent gateway plugin that connects smart glasses and other devices to an agent. Devices can send questions with photos or recordings, receive spoken answers and reminders, and respond to approval requests; devices that cannot keep a connection open can use the documented HTTP routes.

item.title: hermes-teammates (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Hermes Teammates adds a configurable roster of named subagents, each with its own instructions, tools, and optional model. It supports background runs, follow-ups that include earlier results, and a Kanban lane where completed cards wait for approval before dependent cards proceed.

item.title: hermes-plan-mode (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Plan Mode is a plugin that lets Hermes explore with read-only tools, write a plan, and block other tools until you approve. After approval, it can implement the plan in the same turn and track progress in a todo list.

item.title: dosbox-mcp (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: dosbox-mcp is an MCP server that connects an MCP-capable agent to a running dosbox-automation emulator. Its tools support session control, screen text and captures, video recording, Lua scripting, keyboard and mouse input, and memory access.

item.title: sugar (Memory & Context)
item.description: Sugar is local-first infrastructure for coordinating coding agents through a durable SQLite task queue, with atomic claims, leases, and a web dashboard or native macOS app. It also provides project and global memory with local semantic search and keyword fallback, plus an append-only event history and tools for reviewing and exporting evidence.

item.title: membase (Memory & Context)
item.description: Membase provides Python and TypeScript clients, a command-line tool, and an MCP server for managing memory used by AI agents. Memory can be hosted in a Membase account or run locally, with tools to add and search memories and connect supported AI clients.

item.title: memoria (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memoria is a persistent memory layer for AI agents that tracks memory changes and supports snapshots, branches, merges, and rollback. It offers semantic search and can be used through Memoria Cloud or a self-hosted setup; the README also documents a Hermes plugin with optional automatic capture.

item.title: monitor (Memory & Context)
item.description: BetterDB Monitor collects and retains Valkey and Redis monitoring data, including slowlogs, command patterns, client activity, and anomaly signals. It provides historical analytics, MONITOR capture sessions, cluster visibility, and alerts, and can run with Docker, Kubernetes, or the CLI.

item.title: hermes-dreaming (Memory & Context)
item.description: hermes-dreaming runs nightly, deterministic memory consolidation for Hermes Agent. A Python script checks conversations and stored memory, then presents proposals for the agent to apply through its regular memory tool; it does not call an LLM or write memory itself. It also records candidate provenance and can report task outcomes when enabled.

item.title: lcm-x (Memory & Context)
item.description: LCM-X is a context engine for Hermes Agent that stores messages in a local SQLite database and compacts older context into a hierarchical DAG of summaries. It keeps the active prompt bounded and provides tools to search, inspect, and expand compacted material.

item.title: optmem-hermes-plugin (Memory & Context)
item.description: Local append-only Hermes memory provider with decay compression, BM25 retrieval and reversible native-memory migration.

item.title: hermes-gbrain (Memory & Context)
item.description: Community Hermes plugin connecting GBrain memory over MCP, with profile setup and maintenance helpers.

item.title: hermes-official-plugins (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Official Plugins is Nous Research’s repository of first-party plugins for Hermes Agent, with one directory per plugin. The README describes plugins for integrations and tools including Home Assistant, Spotify, Weixin, Blender, and Memory Wiki, as well as a model provider; they can be installed through the Hermes plugin catalog.

item.title: hwiki (Memory & Context)
item.description: Markdown wiki memory provider for Hermes with local SQLite FTS5 recall and append-only memory notes.

item.title: HyAtlas-Memory (Memory & Context)
item.description: HyAtlas is a Go memory server with an embedded vector store and in-process BGE-small embeddings. It stores conversation memories across eight layers, supports search and reversible memory updates, and can use LLM calls for extraction and consolidation in Pro and Ultra modes.

item.title: ReMe (Memory & Context)
item.description: ReMe is a local-first knowledge base for AI agents that stores durable memory as editable Markdown files. It turns conversations and resources into daily notes and long-term knowledge, and retrieves relevant passages using BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion. Agents can access a shared workspace through integrations, a CLI, HTTP, MCP, or Python APIs.
